wall_inference.method: room boundary bands; internal wall width follows source polygon gaps; original wall centerlines absent

limitations: Archisketch coordinates are numerical model data, not independent as-built measurements.
Basic and expanded sources have different room widths; keep source coordinates without whole-model rescaling.
Ceiling 2.5m and hinged door leaf 0.8x2.4m are user-specified. Window overrides apply only to measured expanded rooms.
Unmeasured opening sizes, frame allowances and sill heights are provisional.
No catalog furniture geometry or real-photo textures are included in this structural stage.
